name: Quicker – Speed Up Conversions and Reduce Cart Abandonment
author: Wpbens

sections.description:
Quicker is an advanced WooCommerce plugin designed to streamline your store’s checkout process, reduce cart abandonment, and increase conversions. It lets you customize checkout fields, provide product addons, set order bumps or upsells, add conditional fees, enable AJAX-add-to-cart, enforce order amount limits, and more — all in a user-friendly way, without coding.

Make your WooCommerce checkout lightning fast and optimized for sales. With Quicker

Features

  • Reduce checkout friction by using a single-step or multi-step checkout flow
  • Skip the cart page — customers can go directly from product to checkout
  • Customize checkout fields: add, remove, reorder, and conditionally show them
  • Add product addons or upgrades on product pages or at checkout
  • Promote additional offers via order bumps / checkout upsells
  • Enforce minimum or maximum order amounts
  • Add extra fees (service, delivery, or other conditional fees) based on product, shipping method, user role or payment method
  • Provide Cash-on-Delivery (COD) with conditional visibility
  • Show a mini cart / quick cart preview
  • Allow AJAX add-to-cart for simple or variable products
  • Quick view for products: preview product details without leaving the shop page

🔥 WHAT’S NEXT

If you like Quicker, then consider checking out other WordPress Plugins made by the same team:

🔔 MemberHub – MemberHub for WordPress and WooCommerce and Boost your sales
🔔 Filter Plus – It is a WordPress and WooCommerce Product Filter Plugin that allows users to add multiple filtering features like filter by Ratings, Tags, Price Range, Custom Fields etc.
🔔 Discountify – Discount Rules, Dynamic Pricing for WooCommerce
🔔 Bens Email Marketing & Automation – Fast and simple Email Marketing, Newsletters, Automation & CRM for WordPress
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/quicker directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. All Settings will be found in Admin sidebar -> quicker
sections.faq:
Can I edit the checkout fields without code?

Yes — Quicker includes a checkout field editor that allows you to add, remove, reorder fields, and show/hide them conditionally, all from the admin panel.

Does Quicker support multi-step checkout?

Yes — besides single-step checkout, there is support for multi-step flows to improve usability, especially for complex checkouts.

Can I skip the cart page and send customers directly to checkout?

Yes — you can enable direct checkout from product or archive pages, bypassing the cart to reduce friction.

Are there features to upsell or bump orders at checkout?

Yes — Quicker has order bumps and upsells built in so you can promote related products or offers during checkout.

Can I charge extra fees (for example, service or delivery fees)?

Yes — Quicker lets you add extra/custom fees under conditions like specific products, payment or shipping methods, or user roles.

What about variable products and AJAX add to cart?

Yes — AJAX add to cart works for simple and variable products. You can enable that so users don’t need to reload pages to add items.

Is this plugin compatible with all themes / responsive?

Quicker is built following standard WooCommerce hooks and is responsive (works on mobile, tablet, desktop). However, custom themes may need styling adjustments.

Can I set minimum and maximum order amount for my WooCommerce store

Yes, we have a dedicated feature to set the minimum and maximum order amount.

Do you have a dedicated support team?
Yes, we have a dedicated support team to assist our users with any issues.
